description: This file defines the GithubResourceOwner class which implements ResourceOwnerInterface. It encapsulates information about a GitHub user retrieved via OAuth2, providing methods to access user details such as ID, email, name, nickname, URL, and other resource owner data.

classes.name: GithubResourceOwner
classes.description: Represents a GitHub resource owner (user) and provides methods to access their profile information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the resource owner with an optional response array.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the resource owner ID from the response.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address of the resource owner.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the resource owner.

methods.name: getNickname
methods.description: Returns the nickname (login) of the resource owner.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the URL for the resource owner based on domain and nickname.

methods.name: setDomain
methods.description: Sets the domain associated with the resource owner.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the full response array representing the resource owner.
